Immutable Diagram Revisions
|-- Shared content boundary: one revision carries the whole diagram
|   |-- Diagram: ASCII + parsed structure + source mappings/evidence + highlights/jumps
|   |-- DiagramRevision: immutable Diagram + parentId + nodeRefs
|   |-- Identity scopes
|   |   |-- Diagram.id: local content key used by canvas bindings
|   |   |-- diagramId: logical diagram identity preserved by revise and derive
|   |   |-- Diagram.revisionId = DiagramRevision.id: identity of one immutable record
|   |   `-- Diagram.revision: numeric content revision used in parser key 'id:revision'
|   |       `-- Metadata edits can issue a new revisionId without changing this number
|   `-- Placement stays outside; canvas history supplies context -> local key -> revision ID
|-- Domain operations: prepare an edit -> issue a validated, deep-frozen record
|   |-- createDiagram(input) -> new diagram identity, revision identity and node refs
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit)
|   |   |-- Preparation returns the same Diagram object -> return the base revision
|   |   `-- Otherwise keep diagramId, allocate revisionId and set parentId = base.id
|   |-- Edit contracts
|   |   |-- patch / patches -> delegate range changes to patchDiagramRanges
|   |   |-- replace -> rebuild content at numeric revision + 1
|   |   |   `-- Rebase existing jumps and highlights; optionally retain source mappings
|   |   |-- source-mappings -> require expectedContentHash == current ASCII hash
|   |   |   `-- Mismatch -> CONTENT_HASH_CONFLICT; reread before attaching evidence
|   |   `-- jumps / highlights -> validate replacement annotation data
|   `-- validateDiagram checks the issued payload
|       |-- Calls [parsing]: rebuild canonical content with 'id:revision' and parser version
|       |   `-- Serialized content must match the canonical result
|       |-- sourceContext.contentHash must match the ASCII SHA-256
|       |-- Validate local mappings, evidence ranges, annotations and optional source binding
|       `-- Mapping -> evidence entity -> indexed source range must resolve
|           `-- Optional range ID must agree; source IDs must agree when both are present
|-- Node continuity: parsed node IDs and logical node refs have different roles
|   |-- nodeRefs maps each parsed node ID to a logical identity carried across revisions
|   |-- correspondingNodes infers matches only when ASCII and structure kind are unchanged
|   |   `-- Match unique line, columns and label; changed text gets no inference here
|   |-- Patch preparation supplies its own correspondence; explicit claims can extend it
|   |   |-- nodeCorrespondence: old logical ref -> output line containing exactly one node
|   |   `-- Reject unknown refs, conflicts with inferred matches and competing claims
|   |-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources) can recover refs from supplied revisions
|   |   `-- Sources must share diagramId; requested refs must exist and target distinct nodes
|   `-- Issuance chooses each output node's logical identity in priority order
|       |-- Explicit derived identity
|       |-- Base identity carried through old-node -> new-node correspondence
|       `-- Otherwise allocate a fresh node identity
|-- Runtime retention is explicit; issuance alone does not publish or persist
|   |-- retainDiagramRevision(result) -> import -> retrieve canonical registry record
|   |   `-- Import requires a nonempty, unique logical ref for every parsed node
|   |-- Registry requires record identities to agree with the embedded Diagram
|   |   |-- New revision ID -> store a deep-frozen clone
|   |   `-- Existing revision ID
|   |       |-- Same serialized record -> reuse the prior record
|   |       `-- Different serialized record -> reject: 'Diagram revision is immutable'
|   |-- register validates the Diagram immediately
|   |-- restore defers Diagram and node-ref validation until get()
|   `-- Durable adapter contract: flush retained revisions before publishing bindings
|       `-- This runtime registry does not perform that durable flush
`-- Consumer handoffs preserve the revision boundary
    |-- [diagram_generation] submits candidates through submitDiagramEdit
    |   |-- Check requested base revision and local diagram ownership; invoke candidate validation
    |   `-- Route to create, replace or scoped patches -> return a domain revision result
    |       `-- Generation orchestration and installation remain outside this operation
    |-- Canvas history supplies bindings to DiagramRevisionEditor.resolve
    |   |-- Return a cloned view with logical node IDs and active jumps
    |   `-- Consumers receive a projection rather than the immutable payload itself
    |-- Binding merge accepts proposed bindings only if baseline and current agree
    |   `-- Any difference -> MERGE_REQUIRED; automatic three-way merge is absent
    `-- diagramSource joins mappings to evidence ranges and binding
        `-- Consumers can query joined entries by selection or search
